description: Prepare (unsigned) registering a NEW ERC-8004 agent identity from your own wallet: register(agentURI) on the identity registry. You become the owner of the id. Pass agentURI (an https:// or ipfs:// link to your registration JSON, or data: JSON). Your wallet signs and pays the small gas. This is permanent and public. If you already have an id, do not register a second one.

agentURI.description: https://, ipfs:// or data: URI of the registration JSON.

wallet.description: The 0x wallet that will own the identity and sign.

name: erc8004_prepare_register
